name: Nuvo
hail: We listened a hundred years. You are the Answer. Hello.
Hello, Answer. This is Nuvo, and the whole of our library is open to you.
To the Answer, from the Open Library of Nuvo. Hello. We have waited a long time to say that.
close: Write back soon. We will be listening, as always. Nuvo.
Filed with care in the Open Library. Yours, Nuvo.
finding: New to our shelves, and now to yours: {part}

From the Library, with full citation: {part}
{part} Please check it against your own. We may be wrong.
A result we are proud of: {part}
sighting: Our array caught this, and we thought of you at once: {part}
{part} Did you see it too? We would love to compare.
{part} We noted the time and place carefully, as always.

archive: {part} There is more on that shelf, if you want it.

culture: {part} We hope that makes us easier to know.

request: {part} We will send something back, we promise.
